plan.notes: Official UWM Academic Catalog Business: General Business BBA. The catalog publishes requirements with no official semester sequence, so this is recorded as requirements_only. Blocks sum exactly to the published degree total: GER 30 + Business Foundation 21 + Business Core 32 + General Business major 24 + Business Electives 9 + General Electives 4 = 120. Foundation/core courses recorded with exact published titles and credits; choice slots at listed options (MATH 208 or 211; COMMUN 103 or 105; BUS ADM 210 or 211; BUS ADM 330/331, 350/351, 360/361, 370/371 recorded at the standard 3-credit option). International business component recorded at 3 credits from the published list. Competency-area courses recorded as an 18-credit generic block (a minimum of 12 credits within BUS ADM required toward the major). Catalog edition year not printed on catalog.uwm.edu pages; current edition as accessed 2026-10-10.
